DIGITAL WORLD
A COMMUNITY OF RESPECT
Tip: Think before you post. Your words affect real people.

RULES

Four simple rules for a safe, respectful and responsible digital community.
1

BE RESPECTFUL

Use kind and respectful language. Treat other people online the way you would like to be treated.

2

THINK BEFORE YOU POST

Stop and think before sending a message, comment or picture. Remember that digital actions can have real consequences.

3

PROTECT YOUR PRIVACY

Do not share passwords, private information or personal details. Respect other people's privacy too.

4

REPORT HARMFUL BEHAVIOR

If you see bullying, harassment, scams or dangerous content, do not spread it. Report it and ask a trusted adult for help when necessary.
